label: NHIS dependant: property tax assessment ceiling
unit: KRW, combined property tax assessment base
appliesTo: Dependants other than siblings, being assessed on property
why: Assessed on the property tax base rather than on market value, which is a materially lower figure — so a judgement made from what a home would sell for is not the test being applied. There is also a middle band rather than a single cliff, where the property condition is met only if income stays under a much lower ceiling than the general one, and that interaction is where applications fail without an obvious reason.

history.source: Enforcement Rule of the National Health Insurance Act, appended table 1-2
history.note: At or below this combined property tax assessment base, the property condition is met. Above it and up to ₩900,000,000, the condition is met only where annual income is ₩10,000,000 or less. Above ₩900,000,000 the property condition cannot be met. Market price is not the measure — the property tax assessment base under the Local Tax Act is.
